scope: JSDOM, pure-model, CSS parse and SSR checks. No browser visual or performance assertions.

checks.label: New PVE publication receives a stable local detail route
Pending entries are excluded from the public PVE directory
Native PVE routes keep their existing detail paths
Renaming retains the stable PVE identity and searchable former name
Add intent cannot replace a built-in PVE guide
An edit cannot create an unknown PVE guide
Complete PVE guide data passes meaningful field validation
Missing names, entrance, sections and source are reported
Unsafe source protocols are rejected before publication
Over-limit section data is rejected instead of being silently truncated
Duplicate section IDs are reported
Reopening a renamed local PVE guide reads its latest published fields
A single remaining tower section is valid editor data
All seven stages reopen with their stable weekday IDs
Seven-stage editor begins with three independent empty difficulty records
A structured guide revision preserves source rules, reward notes and steps outside the form
Published difficulty details preserve easy and hard independently
Reopening the published seven-day guide preserves every difficulty
Seven-stage missing data is reported at the correct day and difficulty
PVE plans remain scoped to the specific local entry
A plan revision replaces its stable record without duplication
A plan's original creator retains appreciation after another author revises it
Editing a source-derived historical plan does not claim its appreciation
Page identity retains local entry but removes filters and section anchors
Unsafe external page identifiers cannot become page keys
Whitespace-only and reordered lines do not inflate contribution totals
Replaced line ranges count the larger changed side
Maintainers aggregate valid published authors, deduplicate and sort by changed lines
Unattributed history stays unassigned to the current account
Maintenance of one local entry cannot leak to another
New pet credit belongs to its new detail page
New skill credit belongs to its new detail page
New npc credit belongs to its new detail page
New pve-guide credit belongs to its new detail page
Adding a skill branch credits the current skill detail, not a new skill
PVE home includes a scoped add-play editor, not a directory editor
Published local guide becomes a direct navigation and directory destination
Local guide quick links retain the entry and chosen section
Local detail header, source and multi-client entrances render correctly
A quick link selects and scrolls the requested local section
Switching local sections updates the URL while preserving entry and other context
Local section references are rendered as linked entities
Local detail editor retains record identity and entry return route
Local structured sections each have a guide editor and retain entry and stage context
Published local plans show latest text and original submitter
Reordered tower sections resolve by identity rather than array position
Structured PVE sections read guide data instead of replacing controls with article snapshots
Removing the eighth-floor record yields an honest empty section without crashing
Shanhai summon is a reward activity and absent from challenge choices
Seven-day view exposes seven named days and three custom difficulty options
Easy mode shows only its own submitted opponent and reward
Legacy combined notes remain explicit instead of becoming difficulty data
An unfilled difficulty shows pending bosses and its historical reference value
Difficulty changes retain other page query context
The scoped seven-day editor includes both day and difficulty
The reward table independently displays easy, normal and hard data
Day selection stays shareable and does not inherit another day's opponents
Seven-day editor preserves fixed IDs and opens the requested day and difficulty
Editing one difficulty preserves the others across tab switches
Switching back restores the just-edited difficulty text
Seven-day rendered preview uses the real difficulty reader and contains no editor links
Preview difficulty navigation changes preview content without leaving the editor
Generic section reordering preserves IDs and all attached data
Rendered maintainers show ranked identities and explain unassigned history
Page comments use the reading context for relative wiki links
Comment filtering and own-comment voting follow the exact page and user
Creators cannot award their own plan a helpful vote
Reader appreciation records the original plan author UUID
